facts.text: A marker is a marker, Mr. Wick. Please enjoy a fine dinner in Rome, because the evening gets longer.
facts.why: Julius, manager of the Rome Continental, never says this. His real lines to John on Wikiquote include 'One of our finest rooms.' and 'Enjoy your stay.'
The Rome party is Gianna's coronation. Santino's gala is at an art museum in New York.

vibe.verdict: A classy Continental banquet with the marker, the sommelier and the catacombs, one detail off in the lamb dish.
missing: The Bowery King giving John a pistol with seven bullets
Gianna's coronation and her choice at the end
ideas: Swap 'Limoncello on ice' note for 'Seven bullets, one for each million.'
Swap 'Bowery King's chicken and mushroom pies' note for 'Cooked for the king of the pigeons.'
Swap 'Santino's anchovy and rosemary lamb' note for 'Gianna's coronation lamb.'
Swap the 'Place card' text for 'Excommunicado, one hour.'
